description: Gets a Sitecore item by path, ID, Sitecore query or URI.

database.description: The database containing the item. Defaults to master, and is also the drive an id, query or uri resolves against.

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item to retrieve (e.g. {110D559F-DEA5-42EA-9C1C-8A5DF7E70EF9}). Supply exactly one of path, id, query or uri.

language.description: The language of the item to retrieve

path.description: The path of the item to retrieve (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply exactly one of path, id, query or uri.

query.description: The Sitecore query to execute (e.g. /sitecore/content/home/*/*). Supply exactly one of path, id, query or uri.

uri.description: The URI of the item to retrieve (e.g. sitecore://master/home). Supply exactly one of path, id, query or uri.

version.description: The version of the item to retrieve

name: provider-get-item
